description: §23.2.4a E-FOREIGN-006 — a slice inside a `for` body declares a top-level `const a` while crossing `in: { a }`. The crossing-shadow error must fire and NAME the binding wherever the slice sits; before s456 the check was skipped one block deep (its channel was not in the loop body's emit options) and the slice fell through to a generic E-FOREIGN-007 — or, nested further, to nothing at all.
rationale: §23.2.4a: a crossing name that the slice also declares at its top level SHALL be a compile error (E-FOREIGN-006) that names the shadowed binding.
